episodes.title: We Survived a Cult | Amanda Rae's Story of Trauma, Healing & Growth
episodes.description:
Welcome back to From Where We Stand! 💗
@TheAmandaRaeGrant 
In today's episode, we're introducing Amanda Rae as she opens up about her personal experiences in the Order, some challenges she's faced, and the journey of healing from a past she didn't choose.

Together, we reflect on life inside the group, the lasting impact of our upbringing, and what it means to grow, heal, and rediscover ourselves outside of the world we once knew.

Healing isn't always a straight path, and everyone's journey looks different. Through honest conversations like this one, we hope to create a space where stories can be shared, voices can be heard, and others can feel a little less alone.

Our past may be part of our story, but it doesn't have to define our future. 🦋

💗 Subscribe to follow along as we continue sharing real stories of survival, healing, growth, and life after leaving.

#FromWhereWeStand #LifeAfterPolygamy #HealingJourney #SurvivorStories #ReligiousTrauma
